claims.summary: On the event of lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split (probability tending to one), for X_1..X_N i.i.d. uniform on [0,1]^2 and W = 2^(-l_1): for every 1-Lipschitz profile phi of a down-set (in t = x - y, s = x + y the down-set is {s < phi(t)}), every w in [2^(-l_1), 2] and every a > 0, the ramp R = a rho((s - phi(t))/w), rho(u) = min(1, max(0, -u)), has |sum_i R(X_i) - N int R| <= C a sqrt N((log_2(4/w))^(3/4) + sqrt(log N)), C universal.
claims.assessment: Working proof, passed with corrections by one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_monotone_path_ramps_20261018/review.txt): a special case of lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split at the ramp's own mesh (V_j <= C a, Lambda_j <= C a), which gives it for every 1-Lipschitz profile and w >= 2^(-l_1) without the (a/w + a) log N term; second proof by chaining over coarse monotone approximations with Bernstein and a union per level, the coarsest level by lem:mesh-function-discrepancy (b), (c) and Bernstein given the cell counts.
claims.rationale: A ramp along any monotone path, steep or flat in the square's coordinates, pays the Leighton-Shor factor only for the dyadic scales between its width and 1; recorded through lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split.
claims.next_action: The ramp-plus-texture mechanism for stacks of distinct nested staircases: the interpolating ramp by lem:local-factor-discrepancy (b) on a partition adapted to the local stack width, the texture by cor:fine-mesh-function-tube at a coarse mesh of the local gap.

claims.summary: At (4,4), W = 2^(-l_1), on the events of lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split, cor:fine-mesh-function-tube at delta_0 = W, lem:fine-grid-leighton-shor at W and Chernoff's bound for the W-cell counts, for N large: for every lattice down-set D_0 with profile phi, every K >= 1 and m >= 1, with D_i = {s < phi(t) - 2iW} and g = m W y^* sum_(i<K) 1_(D_i), of discrete cost at most 2 and with every boundary of D_i of grid length at least l_0 > 0, |D(g)| <= C (1 + 1/l_0) sqrt(N log N), C universal.
claims.assessment: Working proof, passed with corrections by one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_monotone_path_ramps_20261018/review.txt): for m y^* >= sqrt(N/log N) by lem:fine-grid-leighton-shor (c); otherwise g = R + (R-bar - R) + H with R the ramp of height K m W y^* and width 2KW, R by lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split, R-bar - R by Bernstein given the cell counts with a union over the at most 4^(2/W) staircases, H by cor:fine-mesh-function-tube at its coarse mesh 2W; for one staircase fixed in advance lem:guided-chain-bound (b) with linearity already gives the bound, the corollary adding uniformity over the staircase. The corollary is a composition of recorded statements (lem:cellwise-lipschitz-split at j_0 and at l_1, cor:fine-mesh-function-tube, lem:fine-grid-leighton-shor (c)) along the decomposition into ramp, cell averaging and texture.
claims.rationale: Bunched stacks of piled staircases one cell apart with boundaries of grid length at least l_0, which lem:staircase-bundle-chains' strips miss, meet the one-height target uniformly over the staircase when the staircases are translates of one.
